name: Tigra

abilityDetails.Neutralize: Buff yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.

signatureAbility:
Warrior Spirit
Start the fight with Primal Sense and Huntress Sense for [3 - 12] seconds.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: On Hit, inflict a non-stacking Passive Neutralize of 100% Potency for 2.5 second(s). If this Neutralize is already active, its duration is refreshed instead.
While the Opponent is Neutralized, if they fail to gain a Buff through Chance, inflict Rupture dealing [571.95] Physical Damage over 1 second(s). Cooldown 1 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: While Charging a Heavy Attack and 0.1 seconds after launching a Heavy Attack, all non-contact hits from Special Attacks have a 100% chance to Miss.
If Tigra Interrupts the Opponent's Attack or causes them to Miss while charging this attack, each Hit inflicts Rupture dealing [5,719.5] Physical Damage over 18 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: If the Opponent is far away from Tigra at any point during a Special Attack she gains Unblockable for the next hit.
Landing an Unblockable strike inflicts Rupture dealing [5,719.5] Physical Damage over 8 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Fighting Non-Cosmic Champions
content: If affected by Weakness, Slow, or Exhaustion Debuffs, prevent the activation of Tigra's personal Miss and Unblockable effects.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, alternate between triggering Primal Sense and Huntress Sense. Senses last for 14 seconds. Duration is paused while the Opponent is Neutralized.

Primal Sense: Whenever inflicting Rupture, deal a burst of up to [9,723.15] Physical Damage based on the number of damaging Debuffs on the Opponent. This damage is increased by 100% during Special Attacks.
Huntress Sense: 10% chance for all non-contact attacks from Special Attacks to Miss. Whenever inflicting Rupture or causing the Opponent to Miss, generate 10% of a bar of Power.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit has a 10% chance to inflict Rupture dealing [9,723.15] Physical Damage over 4 seconds.
Each damaging Debuff on the Opponent increases the chance of inflicting Rupture during this Special Attack by a flat 10%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain Primal Sense and Huntress Sense for 14 seconds.
Inflict a non-stacking, indefinite Rupture dealing [571.95] Physical Damage every 0.5 seconds. This Rupture is removed and reapplied each time Tigra lands an Unblockable strike.

abilitySections.title: Secret Ability - Regeneration
content: When Tigra idles for approximately 3 seconds she regenerates a small portion of health.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Warrior Spirit
content: Start the fight with Primal Sense and Huntress Sense for [3 - 12] seconds.
